hints: Work W is energy, with base units kg m^2 s^-2.
I^2 * R represents electrical power (energy per second).
solution: [V * I * t] has base units of energy (kg m^2 s^-2), while [I^2 * R] has base units of power (kg m^2 s^-3).
teacher_walkthrough: Recall work/energy unit: 1 J = 1 N * m = (kg m s^-2) * m = kg m^2 s^-2.
V * I * t is electrical work, so [V * I * t] = kg m^2 s^-2.
I^2 * R represents power P = W / t, so its base unit is (kg m^2 s^-2) / s = kg m^2 s^-3.
distractor_explanations: Incorrectly includes an ampere factor in energy.
Correct. V * I * t is electrical energy (kg m^2 s^-2); I^2 * R is electrical power (kg m^2 s^-3).
I^2 * R is rate of energy transfer (power), so it has s^-3, not s^-2.
kg m s^-2 is force (N), not energy.
